title: Oratomic, which is developing quantum computing hardware and software, raised a $300M Series A led by ARCH Venture Partners, Spark Capital, and Khosla Ventures (Matt Swayne/The Quantum Insider)
summary: Matt Swayne / The Quantum Insider: Oratomic, which is developing quantum computing hardware and software, raised a $300M Series A led by ARCH Venture Partners, Spark Capital, and Khosla Ventures — - Oratomic raised a $300 million Series A to accelerate development of fault-tolerant, utility-scale quantum computers.
